description: Scan & turn photos into clean PDFs. Fits size limits. Offline, no ads. Turn photos and paper documents into clean, ready-to-submit PDFs in seconds — completely offline. Scan or import Scan with your camera with automatic edge detection, or import photos from your gallery. You can even share photos to Folio from WhatsApp or any app. Fix it fast Auto-crop and straighten pages, rotate, reorder, duplicate or delete pages. Make text clearer with Auto, Grayscale or B&W modes. Fit any size limit Need a PDF under 100 KB, 200 KB or 1 MB for an exam, job or government form? Pick the limit and Folio does the rest. Export as PDF or JPG images. Truly private Folio has no internet permission, so your documents never leave your phone. No account. No ads. No tracking. Free and open source (GPL-3.0).
